name: Force Visualizer
description: Draws the forces, which in a sandbox is not debug output but the lesson. A player who can see the torque on a joint learns why the arm bends; one who cannot is guessing. Vectors are scaled logarithmically because linear scaling makes a strong force fill the screen and a weak one invisible, and the interesting comparisons are between forces orders of magnitude apart. The overlay is deliberately a presentation component with no simulation authority: it reads what the solver did and draws it, so switching it on can never change a result — a visualiser that perturbs the thing it measures is worse than none.

inputs.name: show
inputs.description: Force kinds drawn when the overlay is on.

inputs.name: scale
inputs.description: How vector length maps to magnitude. Log keeps forces orders of magnitude apart comparable on one screen.

outputs.name: largestMagnitude
outputs.description: Biggest force currently acting, for scaling the legend.
